piece_limits.name: piece_limits
piece_limits.value: "pattern_pieces"."position" >= 0 and "pattern_pieces"."quantity" between 1 and 100 and ("pattern_pieces"."seam" is null or "pattern_pieces"."seam" between 0 and 10000000)

version_price.name: version_price
version_price.value: ("pattern_versions"."amount" is null or "pattern_versions"."amount" > 0) and ("pattern_versions"."currency" is null or "pattern_versions"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$') and ("pattern_versions"."price_kind" <> 'FREE' or ("pattern_versions"."amount" is null and "pattern_versions"."currency" is null))

profile_measurement_bounds.name: profile_measurement_bounds
profile_measurement_bounds.value: "measurement_values"."min" >= 0 and "measurement_values"."max" <= 10000000 and "measurement_values"."length" between "measurement_values"."min" and "measurement_values"."max" and ("measurement_values"."precision" is null or "measurement_values"."precision" between 0 and 3)
